findings.quote: There are four planned phases of construction, Phase 1 and Phase 2, which allows for east-west traffic to continue, including a bus overlay service for the 504 King, and Phase 3 and 4, which results in a full closure, The diversion plan for impacted service, 503 Kingston Road, 504 King, and 508 Lakeshore, is shown in Figure 1 (Phase 1 and 2) and Figure 2 (Phase 3 and Phase 4).
TTC does not currently have plans to remove or relocate these stops, as the catchment they serve extends deep into the surrounding neighbourhoods.
There is potential for impacts (injury and/or removal) to approximately four (4) trees to due to shifting transit stops to meet required clearances to the crossing.
